name: com.nova.timeline
description: Cinematics and sequences (Unity Timeline): a Timeline asset (.playable) with Animation, Activation, Audio, Signal and Cinemachine shot tracks, played by a Playable Director (Play On Awake, Wrap Mode Hold / Loop / None, bindings). Animation clips blend with ease in / out and overlaps on top of the Animator. Timeline window: tracks, clips (drag, trim), playhead scrubbing with preview, Play / Pause / Stop. CLI nova timeline.
